domain_specific_rationale: In high-cost generative AI systems, a two-phase credit settlement protocol is vital for financial consistency and fraud prevention. Reserving `estimated_cost_credits` atomically in Phase 1 (QUEUED -> RESERVED) prevents credit overdrafts across concurrent jobs. Settling `actual_cost_credits` or releasing reservations in Phase 2 upon COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED ensures that credits are never permanently stranded even when downstream workers experience fatal hardware faults or unrecoverable exceptions.
capability_impact: Directly preserves CAP-01 (Transactional Integrity) and CAP-14 (Usage & Cost Accounting) across distributed service boundaries.
residual_risk: Orphaned credit reservations caused by worker unresponsiveness prior to Phase 2 completion. Mitigated by automated R02 lease reconciliation releasing or finalizing reservations upon 90-minute safety lease TTL expiry.
